name: card_type
label: Card type
choices: Front — person's name, title, and contact details
Back — HCFM brand and Peyton quote (no editable content)

name: card_name
label: Name on card
help_text: First and last name exactly as it should appear. Not used for back cards.

help_text: Small text below the card image. Describes the print spec.
